description.value: The 100 Mile House Branch of the Cariboo Regional District Library is the public library hub for the South Cariboo region, operated by the Cariboo Regional District. It offers free Wi-Fi, public computers, scanning, and one-on-one tech support — practical amenities for a touring cyclist needing connectivity in a small Interior BC community. The branch also loans a Library of Things collection including specialty items, and hosts regular community programming.

address.value: 449 South Birch Avenue, 100 Mile House, BC V0K 2E0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Wi-Fi as an explicit listed service ('Public computers, Wi-Fi…'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, showers, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; those remain null per absence-of-evidence rules. The phone number matches between OSM and website; the address has a minor street-name format difference ('Birch Avenue South' vs 'South Birch Avenue') which is flagged in concerns but treated as the same location.

A site visit or staff contact to verify washrooms and bike parking would clarify.
